name: Plisse
description: Seersucker: puckered stripes, each column bubbled with soft crinkles, between flat stripes of plain ground.

code.style: --rule: ( --t: @pd(@m(@X, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 50%; background-color: @p(@var(--t)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%, #000 45%, #0000004d 100%) 0 0 / 100% 25%; mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%, #000 45%, #0000004d 100%) 0 0 / 100% 25%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 73%; width: 4%; background-color: @var(--t); opacity: .55; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
